chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) from his father (peace be upon them both) who said:
"Drinking while standing is stronger for you and more healthy."
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on drinking while standing versus sitting?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on food and drink, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the Prophetic tradition of drinking while standing, linking it to physical vigor and health. In Shia jurisprudence, this is often discussed alongside the permissibility of standing versus sitting, emphasizing that while sitting is preferred for humility, standing is encouraged for its medicinal benefits and strength. This ruling underscores the holistic approach of the Imams, integrating spiritual etiquette with practical physiological wisdom.
